title: Exact-load performance proof enforced unavailable compiler telemetry on a target that declares it omitted

source_observation.environment: Exact immutable 2.5.0 baseline launched on trusted Factorio 2.0.77 during the 2.5.5 calibration campaign
source_observation.fact: The exact base load completed successfully and emitted no required MIR_PERFORMANCE_PHASE log events. The 2.0 campaign explicitly has phase_lanes: [] and artifact_volume_policy: omitted-by-capability. The generic runner nevertheless required snapshot, graph, planning, and postconditions phase events; its evidence validator also required modern artifact-volume surfaces, and its settings override declared Factorio 2.1 rather than the governed line.

reproducer.expected: A campaign requires probe phases and compiler artifact volume only when its governed target capabilities declare them; exact package and compatibility lanes remain mandatory for a target that omits those telemetry capabilities.
reproducer.observed: Factorio created the exact baseline save successfully, then the runner failed with 'Performance probe phase snapshot is absent or invalid'.

stable_id_and_migration_impact: none; target-tier telemetry interpretation and evidence validation only
